changelog:
stitch-design-taste 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a semantic skill for generating agent-friendly DESIGN.md files for Google Stitch.
- Enforces premium anti-generic UI standards covering typography, color calibration, asymmetric layouts, micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
- Provides detailed, opinionated rules and banned patterns for colors, fonts, layouts, motion, and components.
- Encodes explicit anti-patterns and AI design clichés to avoid.
- Designed as a single source of truth for creating curated, high-agency, non-generic interfaces with Stitch.
